attempt: Omit Categories from each internal material helper item and assume creative search will show only the main Adaptive Surface item
reason_failed: The Hytale creative search still indexed uncategorized material helper items, so searching Adaptive Surface returned dozens of blocks.
environment: Hytale 0.6.8 client, Adaptive Surface 0.9.3, world-selective helper item assets
conditions: Helper items shared the main item translation key and icon
workaround: Use a dedicated ItemQuality with HideFromSearch=true on every helper, including learned and migrated helpers; Variant=true adds default variant filtering. Keep the main item in Blocks.Soils.

source_refs.description: 0.9.4 creative-search symptom, fix, native checks and user confirmation
